jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: São Tomé and Príncipe has no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance. Its only binding rule relevant to AI is the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing in the 2016 Personal Data Protection Law (Lei n.º 3/2016), supervised by the national data protection agency (ANPDP), which has said it intends to work on AI instruments.
lead_institutions: Agência Nacional de Protecção de Dados Pessoais (ANPDP)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The national ICT institute's website could not be accessed, no online official gazette was found, and the data protection agency's document library could not be read, so only one document could be read: the National Assembly's final approved text of the data protection law. São Tomé and Príncipe is marked for a later retry.

instruments.official_title: Lei n.º 3/2016, de 10 de Maio – Lei de Protecção de Dados Pessoais
instruments.english_title: Law No. 3/2016 of 10 May – Personal Data Protection Law
instruments.issuing_authority: National Assembly (Assembleia Nacional) of São Tomé and Príncipe
instruments.current_status: Cited as 'Lei n.º 3/2016, de 10 de Maio – Lei de Protecção de Dados Pessoais' by the National Assembly in February 2017, when it adopted the law organising the data protection agency (ANPDP) that supervises it; no amendment or repeal was found. The text read is the National Assembly's final text approved in February 2016 (Diário da Assembleia Nacional, II Série, n.º 25, 12 February 2016); the promulgated Diário da República version and its entry-into-force date were not found online.
instruments.summary: São Tomé and Príncipe's general data protection law, applying to the processing of personal data wholly or partly by automated means by public and private controllers. It requires consent or a listed necessity ground for processing, gives data subjects rights of information, access and objection, and in article 13 a right not to be subject to a decision with legal or similarly significant effects based solely on automated processing that evaluates personal aspects such as work performance, creditworthiness, reliability or conduct (with contract and statutory exceptions). It also restricts transfers of personal data abroad, requires notification or prior authorisation of processing by the national data protection authority and sets administrative and criminal sanctions.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The only binding national rule found that governs automated decision-making and profiling (art. 13), and the legal basis for the data protection agency that has said it intends to work on AI instruments.

The law's number and date (Lei n.º 3/2016, de 10 de Maio) are confirmed by the Diário da Assembleia Nacional, II Série, n.º 37 (14 February 2017), which carries the bill on the ANPDP's organisation and cites the law repeatedly. The promulgated Diário da República text was not found online.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. inic.gov.st HTTP 500/proxy refused; parlamento.st reset/503 - Assembly site reached on its host www2.camara.leg.br/saotomeeprincipe (page titled 'Assembleia Nacional de S.Tomé e Príncipe'; hosting by the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies - flagged for review). Text read is the Assembly's final approved text (Diário da Assembleia Nacional II Série n.º 25, 12 Feb 2016); number/date from II Série n.º 37 (14 Feb 2017). Diário da República not online. anpdp.st is a JS SPA. Convention 108 act not found. Units covered: Law: National Assembly website (its own search: 'inteligência artificial', 'artificial', 'algoritmos', 'dados pessoais', 'cibercrime', 'Conselho da Europa'): no AI law or AI bill; the 2025 parliamentary ethics-code bill only mentions AI in passing. Data protection law Lei n.º 3/2016 recorded (art. 13 automated decisions). No online Diário da República search exists; searched, no other AI provisions found.; Government: gov.st portal (no document library, no AI documents); no national AI strategy, public-sector AI guideline or GenAI guidance found. 2020 digital governance strategy and 2025 cybersecurity strategy held as leads (no official text online).; Ministries: Searched, nothing found: no AI documents from education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries (most have no working website).; Regulators: ANPDP (anpdp.st is a JavaScript application; no AI guidance located), AGER telecom regulator (search: only a 2025 Internet Governance Forum news item listing AI as a panel topic), Central Bank BCSTP (search: nothing on AI). No cyber agency or standards body publications found.. Not reached: INIC (inic.gov.st returned HTTP 500 / CONNECT refused); parlamento.st (connection reset; Assembly site reached via its www2.camara.leg.br host instead); ANPDP document library (anpdp.st single-page app, no static document links); Diário da República of São Tomé and Príncipe (no official online portal found).
